Byron Donalds

Republican candidate for Governor and Lieutenant Governor, Florida · Open seat

U.S. Representative for Florida's 19th Congressional District

Byron Donalds is a Republican who has represented Florida's 19th Congressional District in the U.S. House since January 2021, and before that he served in the Florida House from 2016 to 2020. President Trump endorsed him for governor in February 2025, and he won the 2026 Republican primary. In August 2026 he picked state Sen. Bryan Avila of Miami as his running mate for lieutenant governor.

Where Donalds stands

Property taxes
Says that if he is elected governor he will push to eliminate all property taxes. He also pledged to bring back homestead-exemption property tax cuts if the November amendment fails.
Property tax structure
Says Florida should move away from a 'one size fits all' property tax system and has been discussing tax reform ideas while campaigning.
Property insurance
Proposes lowering property insurance rates through tort reform and by expanding home-hardening programs for homes built before 1992.
Education / school choice
Defends Florida's school choice policies when challenged by opponent David Jolly.
Campaign priorities
His campaign website lists affordability, health care, the economy and education among his priority issues.
